purpose: Refine the complete V9 eye closure so the closing and opening stages preserve the eye width and visibly compress only the complete eye body, avoiding a pinched narrow-eye reading.

rejected_or_inactive_candidates.reason: Machine-gated, but self-review found the closing eye narrowed in width instead of reading as a width-preserving vertical compression; retain inactive.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole image reference for the complete V9 eye group, black oval, primary white reflection and tiny white sparkle

reference_policy: Only the locked V9 source may guide image generation. Inactive or rejected blink sheets are not references.

eye_group_contract.complete_group: Open, closing and opening are complete V9 eye groups containing black body, primary white reflection and tiny white sparkle; closed is the rounded closed-eye mark.
eye_group_contract.closing_geometry: preserve open-stage horizontal width and compress vertically from both top and bottom; do not narrow the eye
eye_group_contract.opening_geometry: preserve the same horizontal width and grow vertically from closed toward open
eye_group_contract.pairing: left/right matched paired groups with the V9 upper-left reflection grammar

native_review_gate.threshold: 1bpp black/white with white reflection holes preserved in the source mask
native_review_gate.pair_matching: left/right equal stage height, width delta <=2 pixels and relative black-ink delta <=5%
native_review_gate.stage_order: open and open_return are tallest; closing and opening preserve open width while having intermediate height; closed is shortest
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject narrow pinched eyes, isolated eyelids, caps, changed eye identity, missing reflection/sparkle in open/closing/opening, lashes, winks, sleep eyes, text, labels, grid, border or device frame
